newsitem.title: USA: Jan Bell requests more data from Ocean Reef.
newsitem.headline: Jan Bell requests more data from Ocean Reef.

text.p: Jan Bell Marketing Inc said on Friday that it is responding to a cash merger proposal from Ocean Reef Management Inc, but it is asking for more information on the financing and structure of the deal.
"We've sent a letter to Ocean Reef, which will hopefully serve as a platform for a productive discussion," chairman Isaac Arguetty said in a statement.

Jan Bell said in a statement on October 22 that the offer would give its shareholders $4.00 a share in cash. Ocean Reef Management said October 31, 1996, that it has acquired an option to buy a 6.23 percent stake in the company.
